global_caveats: Never describe zap_actions as Lightning transactions without separate settlement data.
Never sum daily_unique_zappers to obtain weekly distinct zappers.
Treat API observations as public aggregates, not independently audited figures.
suggested_questions: Which metrics changed most from the previous week?
Did activity change mainly through frequency, value, participation, or content volume?
Is the latest week unusual relative to the prior four completed weeks?
Which accurate statistic best illustrates frequent money-native interaction?
